description: CVE vulnerability lookup by CVE ID or keyword combining official NVD 2.0, OSV.dev affected package versions, and CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV). $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

cve.description: Exact CVE ID (e.g. CVE-2021-44228). Pass cve OR q.

limit.description: Optional max results for keyword search (1-20, default 5).

q.description: Keyword search query (e.g. openssl). Pass q OR cve.

name: cve_lookup
